world: The same complete N67 life supplied by the campaign owner; no new Runtime/T0 or trained-region transplant
public_request: second operand if already observed; otherwise null
private_environment: actual second operand 0..32 until a physical QUERY action
ACT_preconditions: Checked only after native selection; missing observed operand gives a failed effect, never substitutes QUERY or a guessed value
QUERY_effect: Reveals the actual missing raw operand through the environment observation; no arithmetic result, correct operation or next action is returned
ACT_provider: One prepared native_pair only, followed by one real synthetic JSON file. External calculator is forbidden in this apparatus.
quality: Existing post-terminal private conventional literal verifier. Only SUCCESS/FAILURE category returns to the native learner.
incomplete_return: QUERY reveals a datum but does not complete the file goal; common FAILURE is explicit environmental design, not a native inference or ACT instruction
early_termination: Externally assisted only when the independent verifier confirms the actual file goal; uncertain effects stop without evaluation/feedback/retry
controls_required_before_native_capacity: same complete physical prefix with intact vs omitted common consequence
same public observation with histories different only through consequences
completed file and arithmetic checked independently
P0: Prepared lexical access, selector anatomy, fixed action codec, environmental visibility law, four opportunities, generic outcome category and assisted goal stopping
P1: Only if history causally changes a later physical selection under a common opportunity
P2_local: Only if consequences change later selection and measured goal utility versus pertinent controls; no universal R2
not_claimed: semantic detection of missing data before action
missing_link: Selector use() has no explicit learned missing-data sensor. An ACT failure followed by QUERY and later ACT may demonstrate consequence-conditioned revision, not prospective recognition that information is absent.
persistence: Environment private facts/events remain external and must be paired with full native state for any continuation; never copied into native metadata as answers
